_comment: MeteoAlarm EMMA warning regions, simplified for point-in-polygon lookup. Coordinates are [lon, lat] (GeoJSON order). Fields: c=EMMA_ID, k=ISO country, n=normalized name, b=[minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat], p=outer rings.
_source: https://github.com/NiklasJordan/meteoalarm (MIT) - derived from MeteoAlarm / EUMETNET region geometry
_license: Region data (c) MeteoAlarm / EUMETNET, CC BY 4.0 - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
_simplification: Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.005 deg, coordinates rounded to 3 decimals, outer rings only
